randomness: none: scripted bids and fixed default schedule; the seed is recorded only
assumptions: Every receiver k < N stops paying right after it receives, with the assumed Klonner & Rai lifetime rate of its half (2.04% for k <= N/2, 0.59% after), applied once; scale 0.5 halves it. Each round's winner is the seat of that round and bids 50% of the enforced ceiling. Bond = (1 - alpha) x O_max (CI 100%). Assumptions, not measurements.
